checks.name: Canonical input hash and preparation tenant binding enforced in storage
Production core fails closed without authoritative adapter
Atomic accepted operation, two conversation mappings, deduplicated two property steps, and one dispatch event
Same-hash replay survives preparation expiry/staleness; changed input conflicts and current response access remains required
Preparation and accepted saved-definition copy cannot mutate
Failure after operation/item materialization rolls back operation, items, steps and dispatch together
Synthetic canonical effect rolls back with receipt/fence failure; successful transaction and replay retain one effect and receipt
Expired worker fenced; completion rollback atomic; completed step cannot be reclaimed; dependent assignment receives prior outcome receipt
Dispatcher lease reclaim retains stable event identity and rejects stale acknowledgement
No PUBLIC execute grants; direct acceptance denied for existing roles: authenticated, service_role
Concurrent replay with expired preparation waits for the accepted key and returns the same durable operation

limits: Synthetic private adapter only; real authorization and canonical effects not integrated
